| 2 + 3 | Yes | They change different files. |
| 1 + 3 | No | One deletes `scripts/old_build.sh`; the other edits it. |

Resolve whether to delete or deprecate the old script. Simply ordering those jobs would either erase the note or leave no file to edit.
